'''Pol Moya Betriu'''{{family name footnote|lang=Catalan|Moya|Betriu}} (born 9 December 1996) is an [[Andorra]]n [[middle-distance runner]] competing primarily in the [[800 metres]].<ref>{{World Athletics}}</ref> He represented his country at the [[2016 IAAF World Indoor Championships|2016 World Indoor Championships]] without qualifying for the final. He is the [[List of Andorran records in athletics|national record]] holder on several distances.

Moya represented Andorra at the [[2016 Summer Olympics]], but did not qualify for the final.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.rio2016.com/en/athletics-standings-at-mens-800m |title=Men's 800m |website=Rio2016.com |publisher=[[Rio 2016 Organising Committee for the Olympic and Paralympic Games]] |access-date=2016-08-22 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20160826085921/https://www.rio2016.com/en/athletics-standings-at-mens-800m |archivedate=2016-08-26}}</ref><ref name="SR">{{cite Sports-Reference |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/mo/pol-moya-1.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190903054714/https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/mo/pol-moya-1.html |archive-date=2019-09-03 |quote=Full name: Pol Moya Betriu}}</ref> He was the [[2016 Summer Olympics closing ceremony flag bearers|flag bearer]] for Andorra for the closing ceremonies.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.olympic.org/news/the-flagbearers-for-the-rio-2016-closing-ceremony |title=The Flagbearers for the Rio 2016 Closing Ceremony |date=2016-08-21 |access-date=2016-08-22 |website=Olympic.org}}</ref>

Moya was born in Spain to Spanish parents. He is studying at the [[Polytechnic University of Catalonia]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.elperiodico.com/es/noticias/deportes/atletismo-andorra-campeonato-del-mundo-portland-pol-moya-4982768 |title=Una bala para Andorra |publisher=El Periódico |date=16 March 2016 |language=Spanish}}</ref>
